propositions: AC items describing operational evidence (deploy, prod, live-run, store-surgery, merge-gate, human-action) without [operator-attested] tag are not detected at plan time, causing close-gate verification failures and retroactive tag addition

A deterministic advisory lexicon lint must flag AC checklist items with operational-evidence markers lacking the [operator-attested] tag, extending p6_ac_quality without adding a new DET check or routing entry

The tag matcher must be single-sourced: det_operator_attested owns _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE and workflow_ops imports it, ensuring the plan-time lint and completion verifier agree on tagged items by construction

The lint must achieve ≥70% precision on a ≥50-item sample, ≤5% flag rate over the frozen AC corpus, and both known-case tickets (115b, 8c4f) must fire on their tag-stripped AC text while already-tagged items must not fire
